graphics_current_state_meaning: No usable graphical path exists yet: qemu-sptm Darwin machine implements no display controller model, creates no framebuffer, and the only in-tree Apple display adapter (apple-gfx) is macOS-ParavirtualizedGraphics-only and not wired to the darwin machine. The guest device tree declares Apple display hardware (disp0 x20, dcp x33, framebuffer x3) but the emulator backs none of it.

component_audit.blocker: No DisplayChangeListener, QemuConsole, or graphic_console registration anywhere in the Darwin machine; zero display symbols in darwin.c.
No DCP/ANS device model exists in qemu-sptm hw/ tree; guest DT nodes disp0/dcp are declared but unbacked.
Gated on macOS-only pvg dependency (ParavirtualizedGraphics + Metal, 22 API refs); CONFIG_MAC_PVG_* absent from the Windows build; not wired to the darwin machine.
CONFIG_RAMFB undefined in build-win; not attached by darwin.c.

component_audit.component: QEMU display backends available on Windows build
component_audit.blocker: CONFIG_SDL undefined, CONFIG_GTK undefined, SDL2/GTK libraries absent from msys64; dbus display needs an external client and a guest display device to consume.

component_audit.component: Input devices wired to Darwin machine
component_audit.blocker: Zero qemu_input usage in darwin.c or xnu; build provides generic usb-kbd/virtio-mouse/virtio-multitouch but no bus wiring or guest-side Apple HID emulation.

runtime_probes.qmp_query_displays: CommandNotFound (command does not exist in this qemu-sptm fork)
runtime_probes.dbus_backend_probe: qemu stays alive with -display dbus (no crash) but no guest display device exists to drive it

input_capability.note: Generic QEMU input devices exist in the build, but no input device is wired to the darwin machine and there is no Apple HID/touch emulation.

conclusion: State D: no usable graphical path exists yet. The guest device tree declares Apple display hardware but qemu-sptm has no display controller model, no framebuffer path, and no usable Windows display backend wired for the darwin machine. The correct next engineering step is a source-backed plan for the smallest display path (likely a ramfb-style framebuffer device + guest DT patch or DCP stub) before any VPhone window can exist.
